title: IBM Z DevOps Testing Fundamentals
learners_amount: 419 learners have completed this activity in the past 12 months.
star_rating: Average rating of 5 stars by 5 learners in the past 12 months.
description:
About this learning activity

This course is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of ZUnit, a powerful unit testing framework specifically tailored for testing z/OS applications and mainframe environments. During this course we will delve into the intricacies of ZUnit, exploring its features, best practices, and practical implementation techniques. 

 

We further expand on the concepts of integration testing, along with introduction to IBM Z Virtual Test Platform (ZVTP) and its combination with the IBM Distribution for Galasa. 

 

Prerequisites

  • Basic z/OS knowledge
  • Familiarity with IDz
  • Basic Java/Groovy knowledge is an asset but is not required
Learn about Testing capabilities in the Z DevOps portfolio with primary focus on Unit Testing via ZUnit plus introductory content to integration testing with ZVTP and the Galasa Testing framework

This course requires you register for an IBMid to access.
